description.value: Superbolt Lab is a specialty tea retail store and tea bar in the Kitsilano neighbourhood of Vancouver, operated by Superbolt™ Tea, a local brand focused on performance and wellness. The shop offers high-grade matcha sourced from a family-run farm in Shizuoka, Japan alongside proprietary functional tea blends formulated with adaptogens and superfoods to support energy, focus, and recovery. It is a distinctive stop for cyclists interested in organic, sugar-free alternatives to coffee and conventional energy drinks.
